name: ccmb-voice-lab
description: Train Claude Code to write like you. Run /voice-training (or any of the 8 sub-skills) to extract your Voice DNA, archetype mix, vocabulary lists, sentence fingerprint, quirks, and tone grid. Compiles into a Voice Template at voice/voice-template.md that every CCMB content skill reads automatically. Based on the Digital Writers Voice Lab by Nicolas Cole and Dickie Bush.
